scope: batch04_only; batch07 handled in another task
tools_actually_used: Python standard library, original project scripts
tool_choice: Reuse the commercially verified generation and local normalization route; Piskel compared previously but not needed for this static batch. No new account/API/payment.
palette_policy: one shared palette per map, at most48 opaque RGB colors across its ground and props
ground_alpha_exception: Ground is fully opaque RGBA filling64x64; transparency and2px margin apply to props, not terrain
